g.text: - Control interface: to select an interface drive GPO pins at reset
- VIO is tied to VCC, so max input votlage is 3.6V
- The Si4707 will default to 2-wire mode, GPO1 = 1, GPO2 = 0
Design heavily based on Si4703 Breakout Board by Nathan Seidle
If external antenna selected the audio jack must be green- wire fixed to ground.
